title: The Name on the Cup Hook
youtube_title: The Name on the Cup Hook | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Remembering a kindness is a way of returning it.
summary: At a harbor shelter on the lee side of the wind, Sable notices that Neighbor Sami has already taken care of a cup hook with your name newly painted. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Sable does one useful thing Neighbor Sami did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
